o1: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in gonad morphogenesis; inductive cell migration; neuron migration; and embryonic body morphogenesis. Located in adherens junction; cell periphery; hemidesmosome; and cytoplasm. Is expressed in hermaphrodite gonad; hypodermis (including dorsal, lateral, and ventral hypodermal cells); and somatic gonad precursor. Is part of the pak-1 pathway. Predicted to interact with pak-1. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in intellectual disability. Orthologous to several human genes including ARHGEF6 (Rac/Cdc42 guanine nucleotide exchange factor 6).
